title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer proficient in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. You will architect high-performance client applications, build reusable design system components with Tailwind CSS, and collaborate closely with product designers to deliver polished, responsive web experiences.

title: Frontend React Developer

title: Staff UI/UX Engineer
description: Lead the frontend architecture for our real-time financial trading platform. Requires deep expertise in TypeScript, WebSockets, Canvas/WebGL data visualizations, micro-frontends, and web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance).

title: Mobile Frontend Engineer (React Native)
description: Develop cross-platform iOS and Android applications using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript. You will build offline-first mobile sync features, native bridge modules, and smooth 60fps gesture-driven animations.

title: Frontend Design System Engineer
description: Build and maintain our enterprise design system in React, TypeScript, and Storybook. Experience with headless UI primitives (Radix UI), token management (Style Dictionary), semantic versioning, and automated visual regression testing is required.

title: Vue.js / Nuxt Full-Stack Frontend Developer
description: Join our e-commerce platform team building server-side rendered storefronts with Vue 3, Nuxt 3, Pinia, and Tailwind CSS. Focus on search engine optimization (SEO), sub-second page loads, and internationalization (i18n).

title: Lead Frontend Architect

title: Junior Frontend Web Developer
description: Ideal for developers with 1-2 years building web interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript (ES6+), and React. You will build user-facing features, fix UI bugs, and write unit tests using Vitest and React Testing Library.

title: Senior Backend Node.js Engineer
description: Architect scalable distributed backend microservices using Node.js, Express, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. You will design event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka, implement caching with Redis, and maintain 99.99% API uptime.

title: Backend Go / Golang Systems Engineer
description: Build high-throughput, low-latency networking services in Go (Golang). Requires experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, concurrency patterns (goroutines, channels), and distributed consensus systems.

title: Python Backend API Engineer

title: Staff Java / Spring Boot Engineer

title: Rust Backend Systems Developer
description: Build memory-safe, ultra-high performance server engines using Rust (Tokio, Actix-web). Strong knowledge of async Rust, zero-cost abstractions, network protocols (TCP/UDP/QUIC), and system security auditing.

title: Backend Distributed Systems Engineer
description: Architect distributed key-value storage nodes handling petabyte-scale datasets. Expertise in C++ or Go, Raft/Paxos consensus algorithms, LSM trees, and replication topologies under network partition scenarios.

title: Senior Cloud API Engineer (TypeScript/Serverless)
description: Build serverless backend architectures using Node.js, TypeScript, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and EventBridge. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK or Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Junior Backend Developer

title: Senior Data Engineer

title: Business Intelligence & Data Analyst
description: Translate complex multi-source business data into actionable executive insights. Proficient in advanced SQL, Tableau, Power BI, cohort retention analysis, and communicating metric trends to cross-functional leadership.

title: Real-time Streaming Data Engineer
description: Build low-latency streaming pipelines processing 500k+ events/sec using Apache Flink, Kafka, and ClickHouse. Experience with event time semantics, watermarks, exactly-once state management, and RocksDB state backends.

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description: Architect enterprise healthcare data warehouses complying with HIPAA standards. Expertise in Google BigQuery, Google Cloud Dataflow, Star/Snowflake schemas, data lineage tracking, and master data management.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description: Assist in building automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, pandas, SQL, and AWS S3/Redshift. Write unit tests for data transforms, monitor pipeline alerts, and maintain clean database schemas.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design, train, and deploy production machine learning models using PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, and Python. Experience serving models at scale with Triton Inference Server or TorchServe, featuring low-latency inference and real-time feature stores (Feast).

title: LLM Applications Engineer (GenAI / RAG)
description: Build cutting-edge generative AI applications using Large Language Models, LangChain/LlamaIndex, and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate). Implement semantic search, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, embedding fine-tuning, and LLM evaluation benchmarks.

title: Computer Vision Research Engineer
description: Develop deep learning algorithms for 3D object detection, semantic segmentation, and sensor fusion in autonomous mobile robots. Proficient in PyTorch, OpenCV, CUDA programming, and model quantization (TensorRT, ONNX).

title: NLP / Conversational AI Scientist

title: MLOps Platform Engineer
description: Build continuous machine learning deployment infrastructure. Expertise in Kubeflow, MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, automated model retraining triggers, model drift detection, and GPU cluster resource scheduling.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer

title: Junior DevOps Engineer
